description: A standalone GitHub-compatible git forge in one process: smart-HTTP clone/push, REST v3, GraphQL v4 and MCP tools, all over an in-memory store. v5 is a from-scratch Go rewrite of v4: a statically linked Go core (raw-TCP HTTP/1.1, zero-alloc hot paths, cached packs) behind a thin Node launcher.
name: makefun-github-core-clone-01-v5
